model: frozen B2 v2 (same booster as b2_ecmwf); no NCMRWF-trained model exists
calibration: NONE for NCMRWF. b2_ncmrwf outputs use the ECMWF validation-2021 isotonic calibrator and are labelled 'cross-system transfer; NOT validated for this provider'. A calibration.json here must be fitted on an NCMRWF VALIDATION period only (fitted_on: validation) - enforced in b2_provider.provider_calibrator.
spread_reference: ECMWF IFS ENS TRAIN 2018-2020 (cross-system transfer until an NCMRWF TRAIN reference is retrieved)
benchmark: NONE. No real NCMRWF forecasts have been retrieved in this environment (see artifacts/ncmrwf_tigge_availability.json).
